Derive Contrasts from a Sample Annotation

Source: R/compute_cf_dea.R
derive_contrasts.Rd

Two annotation layouts are in use and both have to work:

Usage

derive_contrasts(annot, annot_label = "the annotation")

Arguments

annot

Data frame read from the annotation file.

annot_label

Name used in error messages, normally the file name.

Value

A named character vector of contrast expressions.

Details

* **explicit** — `Contrast` holds the linear-model expression and `ContrastName` its label. Taken as given. * **dataset** — `Group` names the experimental group and `Control` marks it as control (`C`) or treatment (`T`). Every treatment-versus-control pair is generated, named `<treatment>_vs_<control>` and expressed with the `G_` prefix prolfqua gives group coefficients.

Column names of the dataset layout are matched case-insensitively: annotations in the wild spell the second column both `Control` and `CONTROL`.
